_decision: Active-path tree row labels must keep a line-height at or above the font's safe descender clearance. pathEmphasis() previously returned 'leading-none font-medium' for active-path rows, which compiled to line-height: 14px on a 14px font — a line box exactly equal to the font size. Combined with this same span's own `truncate` (overflow: hidden), descenders on g/y/p/q/j were clipped: 'System logic' (y, g) and 'Monthly' (y) lost the bottoms of their letters, while rows without a descender looked fine, which is why it read as intermittent.
_corrected: An earlier version of this field cited 'Schedules' as an affected label, copied from the divergence record without checking it. 'Schedules' contains no descender at all and was never affected — see L-34's CORRECTION note in sandbox/src/data/rail-sidebar.ts. Recorded here because the same unverified detail propagated through three files: repeating a decision record's own prose into a check spec is not verification, and a spec that cites a false example would certify the wrong thing if anyone ever reasoned from it.
_why_these_four_properties: The bug is an INTERACTION between two properties, so checking either alone would pass while the defect is present. line-height 20px vs font-size 14px is the descender clearance; overflow/text-overflow/white-space confirm the truncation half is still there, since 'fix' by deleting truncate would satisfy a line-height check and silently remove the horizontal ellipsis the row also needs.
_scope: Anchored to the SELECTED leaf's label. An unselected row measures 20px whether or not the bug is present and would prove nothing — only active-path rows ever received the leading-none treatment.
